objective: Execute the already-frozen Iwanaga-shaped prior-SPX / JNU intraday-path family on exact-product OSE Nikkei 225 Micro minute data without proxy substitution or window rescue.

target.cloud_output: daily non-reconstructive FIRST30/MIDDLE/LAST30 returns + hashes/manifest only

predictor.definition: prior completed U.S. cash-session close-to-close log return
predictor.causal_alignment: For each JNU trading date use the most recent completed S&P 500 trading date strictly earlier than the Japanese trading date; never forward fill an unavailable U.S. return beyond that causal rule.

windows.FIRST_30M: Day-session 1-minute bars with timestamp >= historical day-session open and < open+30 elapsed minutes.
windows.LAST_30M: Day-session 1-minute bars with timestamp >= historical day-session close-30 elapsed minutes and < day-session close.
windows.MIDDLE: Eligible day-session 1-minute bars between FIRST_30M and LAST_30M.
windows.return_definition: log(last close / first close) within each fixed state window, identical endpoint convention to proxy G2.

hypotheses.universal_model: state fixed effects + one universal prior_SPX slope
hypotheses.interaction_model: state fixed effects + separate prior_SPX slope by FIRST30/MIDDLE/LAST30
hypotheses.expected_result: interaction model lowers OOS MSE versus universal slope

oos.secondary: sign accuracy for H1/H2; coefficient stability; post-2024-11-05 regime diagnostics

H1_H2: Final expanding coefficient has preregistered expected sign
Full-OOS MSE improvement vs intercept-only baseline > 0
Model sign accuracy is not worse than baseline
H3: Full-OOS daily average state MSE improvement of interaction model vs universal-slope model > 0
pass_rules.family: All H1/H2/H3 cell gates must pass and one-sided bootstrap p-values (1-P) must pass Holm alpha=0.10.

recent_regime_diagnostic.rationale: Known OSE day-session extension, fixed independently of outcomes
recent_regime_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; report coefficient/loss direction, not an extra post-hoc rescue gate

interpretation.pass: TRUE_JNU_INTRADAY_PATH_INFORMATION_PASS; only then may a trading-rule translation be preregistered. Not automatic live alpha.
interpretation.fail: REJECT_TRUE_JNU_CURRENT_SPEC; no window tuning, predictor switching or indicator rescue.
interpretation.data_inconclusive: Only if causal aligned sample or required windows are insufficient before statistical evaluation.

forbidden: Use SPY, ES, NQ or QQQ as replacement after seeing true-JNU outcomes
Drop H1, H2 or H3 after results
Add technical indicators/regimes to rescue failure
Use 225Labo raw outside local personal-use boundary
